note: Horses stop shooting off like rockets: ridden horses now travel one continuous journey at their own speed instead of teleporting between the stable, the workplace, and the patrol circuit, the evening walk home runs at walking pace, and wild horses graze in a slow circle instead of vanishing to a random spot every few seconds. The fastest any NPC horse moves now is a calm ride, slower than your own horse. Your own horse still waits where you left it in Mosslight — walk up to it and press Mount to ride, and dismounting leaves you standing right there, never teleported
